name: Across the Board Game Café
why: Hundreds of board games, quiet rooms, cheap, nobody has to talk about work

name: Forth Café & Bar
why: Coffee by day, cocktails by night, easy for a first meet

name: The Forks Market
why: Everyone can pick their own food, big communal tables, river walk after

name: Assiniboine Park (Leo Mol Sculpture Garden)
why: Free, walkable, good for a slow Sunday group

name: The King's Head Pub
why: Pub trivia Tuesdays, live music weekends, loud in a good way

name: Burton Cummings Theatre
why: Concerts; the agent checks the listing and forms a group around a show

name: Winnipeg Art Gallery – Qaumajuq
why: Inuit art centre, Friday late openings, conversation starters everywhere

name: Duke of Kent Legion (Bingo Night)
why: Ironic bingo, cheapest night out in the city, wildly mixed crowd

name: Clementine
why: Brunch worth waking up for; good for a smaller Sunday group

name: Sargent Sundae
why: Ice cream then a walk in Assiniboine Park; zero pressure

name: Assiniboine Park Bike Loop
why: Saturday morning group ride, all paces

name: Sargent Park Courts
why: Pickup basketball; the agent fills a 5-on-5

name: McNally Robinson Booksellers (Grant Park)
why: Author events and a café; the agent forms a group around a reading

name: Nonsuch Brewing Co.
why: Big tables, Belgian beer, easy to add one more person

name: Kildonan Park Trails
why: Evening walk along the Red River; good for low-energy weeks

name: The Rec Room
why: Arcade, axe throwing, big groups, loud

name: Times Change(d) High & Lonesome Club
why: A small listening room: blues, roots and jazz most nights, cheap cover, people who came for the music and stay seated

name: Dave Barber Cinematheque
why: Repertory and festival films with a lobby that empties into the Exchange's cafés; a quiet night with something to talk about after

name: The Handsome Daughter
why: Local bands, DJ nights and a big patio; the West End's living room for anyone into music

name: Thom Bargen Coffee
why: Daytime and early-evening coffee with room for a small table; good for readers, writers and first meetings

name: Winnipeg Squash Racquet Club (drop-in)
why: Drop-in squash and racquet sports for people who'd rather sweat than sit; courts book by the hour

name: Video call (online)
why: An introduction that needs no room: a video call on the person's own tool, at a time both agree
